mentions.name: dhee
mentions.description: A reader application for the Rigveda Samhita, designed to support reading old Indic texts with plans to potentially support others in the future. Inspired by the University of Cologne's vedaweb.
mentions.source_excerpt:
dhee (https://dhee.apratiratha.in, https://github.com/mahesh-hegde/dhee).

An application to read Rigveda Samhita, and potentially other old indic texts in future. Inspired by University of Cologne's vedaweb.
